Package io.webagent4j.crawler.api

Record Class CrawledPage

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawledPage
Record Components:
requestedUrl - the URL the fetch attempt started from
finalUrl - the URL actually reached, after following any redirects
depth - this page's crawl depth (a seed is depth 0)
discoveredFrom - the page this URL was discovered on; absent only for a seed
statusCode - the final response's HTTP status code (always 2xx)
headers - the final response's headers, preserving multi-value order
contentType - the final response's Content-Type, without parameters
charset - the charset the body was decoded with, when one could be determined
html - the decoded response body
title - the document's <title> text, when present and non-blank
declaredCanonicalUrl - the page's declared <link rel="canonical"> target, resolved to an absolute URL; never automatically substituted for finalUrl
links - every navigation link extracted from this page, in document order, including rejected ones
redirectChain - every redirect hop followed to reach finalUrl
responseBytes - the final response body's size in bytes
fetchDuration - monotonic-clock-measured time spent on this page's entire fetch attempt, including every redirect and retry - never measured against a wall clock, which can jump backwards or forwards independently of elapsed time
provenance - where this page came from
public record CrawledPage(URI requestedUrl, URI finalUrl, int depth, Optional<URI> discoveredFrom, int statusCode, Map<String,List<String>> headers, String contentType, Optional<Charset> charset, String html, Optional<String> title, Optional<URI> declaredCanonicalUrl, List<DiscoveredLink> links, List<RedirectHop> redirectChain, long responseBytes, Duration fetchDuration, CrawlPageProvenance provenance) extends Record
Immutable representation of one HTML page successfully fetched during a crawl.

Every collection is defensively copied and returned unmodifiable; no mutable state escapes this type.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
